english.title: Use a radio / audio / video equipment on the Midland Metro in a manner causing nuisance / giving grounds for annoyance
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) used

(A)_[a radio]_
(B)_[audio equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF AUDIO EQUIPMENT..),]_
(C)_[video equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF VIDEO EQUIPMENT..),]_

in a manner which may have caused nuisance or given reasonable grounds for annoyance to another person on the system
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 10(c) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989
